data.one_liner: Widget to display network images with caching, loading indicators and fade transitions.
data.what_it_does: FastCachedNetworkImage downloads images, stores them in a Hive cache, and serves them from local storage on subsequent loads. It provides customizable loading and error widgets, progress reporting, and fade‑in animations.
use_when: You need offline access to frequently used images
You want built‑in progress indicators or custom loaders
You target multiple platforms including web and desktop
avoid_when: App size must be minimal and you can’t afford extra dependencies
You need fine‑grained cache policies beyond simple TTL
You require advanced image manipulation or transformations
strengths: Supports progress, error handling and fade animations
Works on mobile, web and desktop out of the box
weaknesses: Relies on Hive for storage, adding another dependency
Cache management is limited to clear‑all or per‑image deletion
Large images may still consume significant disk space
data.setup_notes: Call FastCachedImageConfig.init() (optionally with subDir and clearCacheAfter) before runApp; ensure hive_ce_flutter is added; no special permissions required.
